regions.region: page 1 title, abstract, author block, introduction, and SI availability marker
regions.finding: Confirmed the article title 'Iron Catalysis for Room-Temperature Aerobic Oxidation of Alcohols to Carboxylic Acids' and the aggregate Fe(NO3)3·9H2O/TEMPO/MCl aerobic oxidation claim. The article advertises SI, but the workspace association is unestablished and no SI fact was inferred.

regions.region: page 1 right-column initial lauraldehyde observation and Table 1
regions.finding: Eight distinct aldehyde-oxidation records were created: four substrates under separate O2/12 h and air/16 h conditions, all at 1.0 mmol in 4.0 mL DCE, with isolated yields linked to their products. The prose 1a observation is the Table 1/O2 run and is not duplicated.

regions.region: page 1 lower-right Scheme 1 and cross-page metal-nitrate prose
regions.finding: Five metal-nitrate screen conditions were retained separately. Fe and Cu outcomes include printed times/product outcomes; Co/Ni/Zn retain 84%/83%/100% starting-material recovery from the page-1/2 prose without inventing a duration.

unresolved: Most page-1 experiments omit operational workup, purification, product masses, and some analytical bases.
The Co/Ni source formulas are preserved as printed despite unusual nitrate stoichiometry; no silent chemical correction was made.

regions.region: page 2 upper-left continuation of Scheme 1 screen
regions.finding: The cross-page prose completes the Zn 100% recovery statement and says Cu nitrate is slower; these facts enrich the existing Scheme 1 screen records rather than create duplicates.

regions.region: page 2 left-column Table 2 including all 17 rows and footnotes a–f
regions.finding: Thirty-two distinct alcohol-scope records were created by separating O2 and air columns. Shared 1.0 mmol/4.0 mL DCE conditions and row-specific 36/48 h, 20 mol% TEMPO, and 20 mol% Fe overrides were applied only to the printed rows. Air dashes in entries 16–17 remain absent outcomes rather than zero-yield experiments.
Separated O2 and air preparation of octanedioic acid (86%/83%, 48 h) from the NaCl/O2 selective octanedial experiment (58%, 12 h).

regions.region: page 2 center-right Scheme 3 and scale-up prose
regions.finding: Four distinct large-scale records were retained: 40 mmol O2, ordered 40 mmol air then O2 supplementation, its incomplete air-only comparison with separate acid/aldehyde NMR yields, and the 240 mmol slow-air-flow run. Printed masses/yields and the 1.5 h first stage/21.5 h overall timing remain separate.
Retained separate O2 and air oxidation of 3r to sclareolide plus the distinct 3s steroid oxidation with the 15 mol% TEMPO override and concurrent secondary-alcohol-to-ketone change.

unresolved: Most scope entries omit workup, purification, and isolated mass.
The post-air pure-O2 stage duration in Scheme 3 equation 2 is not printed and was not calculated from the overall time.
Compact heterocyclic/steroidal structures remain label-only where uncertain.

regions.region: page 3 upper-left Scheme 5 and total-synthesis prose
regions.finding: The KCl/air oxidation is merged with Table 2 entry 11 air. The distinct NaCl/O2 oxidation, TMSCHN2 esterification, two separate prolinol EATA conditions, and KOH hydrolysis to phlomic acid were retained as independent stages; 83%, 58/48%, and 92% values were not reassigned across stages.
Retained separate piperitol and THP-protected benzenedimethanol aldehyde-forming runs, plus separate O2 and air lactone-forming conditions for 1,2-benzenedimethanol.
The H2(18)O experiment retains 1 equiv isotope reagent, standard catalysts, O2/DCE/12 h, 99% isolated yield, and 40% oxygen-18 incorporation as distinct product-specific outcomes.

regions.region: page 3 right-column mechanistic observations before Table 3
regions.finding: Main-text-only records retain the 3a time course, NaCl 4 h failure, 5 mol% prior-condition aldehyde control, qualitative counterion order, and separate 18-crown-6/kryptofix slowing controls. Cited but unassociated SI traces/rows were not reconstructed.

Six component-control rows were retained independently with explicit reagent omissions, 12 h conditions, starting-aldehyde recovery, acid yield, and peracid yield. Numeric zeros remain source values; dashes only omit components.
The printed KCl 0 or 10 mol% alternatives were split into two no-TEMPO controls, each with 100% recovery of alcohol 3a after 12 h and no acid formation.
NO2 observation/NO detection and the proposed Fe/TEMPO/NOx/alcohol-to-acid cycle are linked to one mechanism record spanning pages 3–4; proposed intermediates are not preparations.

unresolved: SI pages cited for kinetics, counterion tests, detection methods, and apparatus are not associated and were not imported.
Many Scheme 5–8 records omit scale, solvent amount, workup, purification, mass, or analytical basis.
Complex allene/natural-product/isotope structures remain label-only and unverified.

regions.region: page 4 upper-left continuation and full Scheme 9
regions.finding: Completed inspection of the proposed Int 1–4 Fe/TEMPO mechanism, ligand exchange, aldehyde hydration, and NOx/O2 redox cycle. It remains a mechanism record with explicit author uncertainty, not reaction preparations of the intermediates.

regions.region: page 4 left-column summary, associated-content statement, author information, and acknowledgments
regions.finding: The summary restates the method and total synthesis without adding a new experiment. The SI availability statement does not establish an associated workspace SI file. The supplied prolinol acknowledgment adds no separable reaction run.

Bibliography and prior-literature/safety context only. External papers were not expanded into current-paper experiments, and the DCE/O2 hazard note does not add a reaction condition to unspecified records.

unresolved: The authors explicitly state that further mechanism studies are required.
No new preparative operation occurs on page 4.
SI association remains unestablished despite the associated-content notice.
